name: hollywood-groove-functions
description: Firebase Cloud Functions for Hollywood Groove scoring and engagement

scripts.serve: npm run build && firebase emulators:start --only functions --config ../firebase.json --project theta-inkwell-448908-g9
scripts.shell: npm run build && firebase functions:shell --config ../firebase.json --project theta-inkwell-448908-g9
scripts.deploy: npm run build && firebase deploy --only functions --config ../firebase.json --project theta-inkwell-448908-g9
scripts.test:scoring: npm run build && OPENAI_API_KEY= JAVA_HOME=${JAVA_HOME:-/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@21/libexec/openjdk.jdk/Contents/Home} npm run firebase -- emulators:exec --only database,functions --config ../firebase.json --project theta-inkwell-448908-g9 "node scripts/trivia-scoring-emulator.mjs"
